senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
1 Blown, as a flower.
2 Smilling.
3 Shining.
4 Glad, pleased.
E.
प्र before फुल्ल flowered.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having full or sparkling eyes.
E.
प्रफुल्ल, and नयन the eye.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having a cheerful or smiling countenance, looking gay or happy.
E.
प्रफुल्ल, and वदन face.
